decision: Hardware H.264 inside generic-profile MCAP; original sensor evidence; CPU processing with IDR-safe MP4 and safe Rerun0.41 clip artifacts.

newIssues.title: Specify H.264 MCAP capture schemas and cross-language golden fixtures
newIssues.goal: Give Android, iOS and Python one testable source contract before encoder implementation.
newIssues.scope: Materialize stateaction.capture.v1 / h264_mcap_v1 strict JSON Schemas, pinned Foxglove Protobuf descriptor/generated bindings, bridge fixtures, clock/frame evidence and explicitly classified legacy JPEG samples.
acceptanceCriteria: Generic MCAP header profile is empty; Protobuf video, reviewed CDR sensors and JSON evidence declare their exact encodings. Full transitive FileDescriptorSet and schema revisions/hashes are embedded; mixed files never falsely claim the ROS2 profile.

One complete Annex B access unit per foxglove.CompressedVideo message; capture time, optical frame_id, source frame ID, video sequence, encoder PTS/time base and terminal outcome are distinct and round-trip exactly.
Independent raw-motion, sensor/calibration, requested/supported/enabled/observed inventory and final close/drop/count schemas include unavailable/unknown states and large integers as decimal strings.

Golden valid/delayed/partial/config/IDR fixtures and malformed B-frame, missing config, duplicate/missing PTS, unequal-clock, tracking-loss, calibration-reset, truncation and historical JPEG fixtures have explicit expected outcomes.
newIssues.validation: Run Kotlin/Swift/Dart/TypeScript/Python conformance fixtures and independently decode a golden MCAP; inspect descriptor/schema hashes, counts and original timestamp preservation.

newIssues.title: Implement Android hardware H.264 frame messages in MCAP
newIssues.goal: Record phone RGB using MediaCodec without losing source frame identity or sensor evidence.
newIssues.scope: Implement capability negotiation and hardware encoder adapter for the candidate 1080p30 / Main 4.0 / no B frames / 12 Mb/s / one-second IDR profile; use native buffers and generic mixed-schema writer.
acceptanceCriteria: Unsupported required profile returns an explicit preflight error; no silent JPEG/HEVC/software/raster/FPS fallback. Record actual codec identity/color/raster/settings and inspect the emitted bitstream, not only requested MediaFormat hints.

Handle output offsets, codec-config and partial buffers; assemble whole frames, repeat SPS/PPS at IDRs, preserve acquisition IDs through unique encoder PTS and nanosecond evidence, and release buffers promptly.
Enforce bounded pending frames/access-unit/writer bytes and account for written/dropped/unresolved events; imagery is not sent over the Flutter bridge.
Two consecutive signed-device sessions produce readable indexed MCAP and matching native/frame/PTS counts; unsupported, tracking-loss and encoder-error cases are explicit.
newIssues.validation: Physical Android short sample plus decoder/bitstream receipt; check hardware use, no B frames, actual IDR interval, timestamp identity, raster/color and buffer bounds.

newIssues.title: Implement iOS hardware H.264 frame messages in MCAP
newIssues.goal: Record RGB with VideoToolbox while retaining original AR/camera acquisition identity.
newIssues.scope: Implement native capability/encoder/writer adapter, source-frame references, actual parameter sets and length-prefix-to-Annex-B conversion under the shared candidate profile.
acceptanceCriteria: Probe hardware support, disable frame reordering, honor or explicitly reject the selected profile and record actual encoder/raster/color/configuration; never silently switch format or software encoding.
Use sourceFrameRefCon/PTS identity rather than callback order; obtain NAL length size and SPS/PPS from format descriptions, assemble one complete access unit and repeat configuration with every IDR.
Update the writer uptime-only plausibility guard for the explicit epoch-based MCAP recorder-time policy while preserving original native capture clocks separately.
Bound retained camera/encoder buffers, persist terminal frame outcomes and reset encoder/calibration/session state; two signed-device sessions decode without stale configuration.
newIssues.validation: Physical iOS sample and explicit hardware/bitstream/frame-map receipt; delayed callbacks, nil/config output, interruption and consecutive-session tests.

newIssues.title: Preserve independent raw IMU events and original sensor clocks
newIssues.goal: Make motion evidence truthful and comparable by explicit semantics, not invented simultaneous pairs.
newIssues.scope: Separate accelerometer and gyro acquisition on both platforms, initially request 100 Hz each, preserve original event times/clock/units/axes/accuracy and keep fused motion separate.
acceptanceCriteria: Android never combines latest accel/gyro values under the current callback time; iOS raw acceleration is not replaced by CMDeviceMotion gravity-removed/fused values.
Every delivered event retains exact original timestamp and source identity; requested/effective rates and gaps are measured; mapped time includes declared clock mapping/provenance or null.
Motion queues are independent of visual backpressure; no drain-and-discard when a video write is dropped. Saturation produces explicit accounting and reasoned capture stop.
Fused attitude/derived angular velocity/covariance remain separately named with validity and assumed/unavailable provenance.
newIssues.validation: Native event-level fixtures with unequal accel/gyro schedules and delayed video; physical counts/rates/units/gravity semantics and original timestamp round trips.

newIssues.title: Fix saved-raster calibration, capture settings and tracking-loss RGB
newIssues.goal: Keep saved imagery, calibration and actual device settings consistent.
newIssues.scope: Unify Dart/native profile keys, capability/start negotiation, rate/toggle handling, camera raster transforms and per-session calibration reset; separate RGB availability from AR pose tracking.
acceptanceCriteria: Requested 1080p30 is honored and observed or explicitly unsupported; no hardcoded hidden 15Hz path or ignored channel toggles. Effective native rates/raster and intentional sampling are recorded.
Saved-pixel intrinsics and source/output crop/resize/rotation/mirror transforms match every frame/calibration revision; iOS depth calibration state resets between recordings.
Tracking loss invalidates estimated pose but does not suppress required RGB; origin/reset events remain explicit. Unverified clocks and depth associations are not reported synchronized.
Consecutive-session, orientation, resolution rejection, tracking-loss and saved-raster geometry fixtures pass on both platforms.
newIssues.validation: Compare decoded saved raster and overlay geometry against native metadata; two physical sessions/platform with pose-tracking loss and settings rejection.

newIssues.title: Preserve available depth, confidence and honest sensor provenance
newIssues.goal: Retain available conditional evidence without claiming unsupported sensors or measured accuracy.
newIssues.scope: Version conditional depth/confidence/native precision and camera metadata; correct fabricated confidence/covariance/extrinsic certainty and optional mesh/point-cloud semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: Depth/source-kind/native units/precision/validity/calibration/time and matching confidence are retained when supported/enabled; unavailable is explicit. Raw ARCore depth is still estimated and is never conflated with dense depth.
Do not silently quantize original float depth or duplicate low-rate depth to meet a requested cadence; any derived representation has explicit conversion/source mapping.
Preserve exposed exposure/focus/sensitivity/readout fields or unavailable declarations; distortion/extrinsic assumptions and static noise/confidence placeholders are labelled rather than measured.
Optional mesh/point clouds distinguish actual events, final snapshots and unsupported streams; nonfinite observations remain preserved with flags. No audio/GPS or metric-accuracy scope is added.
newIssues.validation: Depth-capable and non-depth capability fixtures plus physical samples where available; confirm stored native precision, source-matched confidence and metadata provenance.

newIssues.title: Make native capture finalization bounded and evidence complete
newIssues.goal: Never present unfinished, dropped or overwritten acquisition evidence as a complete source.
newIssues.scope: Implement bounded producer/writer/evidence queues, durable actual-write/drop accounting, encoder EOS/close lifecycle, session resets and explicit low-disk/thermal/interruption/crash handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Initialize actual frame/system/drop evidence sinks; success counters follow writer acceptance, all submitted frames have terminal outcomes, and inline evidence is retained until any required sidecar closes durably.
Stop producers, drain encoder to EOS under deadline, reconcile pending IDs, drain/close MCAP/indexes/footer, close sidecars and atomically finalize metadata before closed-file acknowledgement.

Writer/index/encoder/IMU/evidence memory and finalization time are bounded; low storage/critical heat initiates a reasoned stop with reserve instead of silent fidelity reduction or pending-source deletion.

Capture/drain/hash crashes, unresolved frames and writer errors remain recovery-required/quarantined. Explicit salvage creates a derived identity/hash retaining original bytes; no automatic upload as complete.
Separate container_state from capture_outcome: a cleanly closed shorter interrupted take may upload with explicit interruption/QC; unclosed/malformed/unresolved sources cannot auto-admit.
newIssues.validation: Native fault injection plus signed-device stop/interruption/disk/thermal/reset runs; actual attempted/submitted/written/dropped/unresolved counts, sidecar existence, footer and stable-file evidence.

newIssues.title: Implement durable Android background multipart uploads
newIssues.goal: Replace the current Android unsupported-upload path with the same owner-bound protocol used by iOS.
newIssues.scope: Implement native OS-scheduled file transfer, durable part/task/retry journal and Flutter bridge under API-issued frozen plans; select supported Android scheduling paths in the mobile specification. API 34+ uses visible-action JobScheduler UIDT; older supported Android uses foreground WorkManager. Native control API client renews signed URLs while Dart is suspended.
acceptanceCriteria: Android uploads real files via API-issued direct multipart PUTs, one source/64 MiB parts/two PUTs/three temporary chunks, and only the API reserves/reconciles/completes/restarts provider uploads.

OS scheduler/notification/foreground permissions and current background limits are implemented and documented for supported API levels, with durable resume after process/device restart; no unlimited-background promise.

Original owner, transport epoch, part identity/ETag/size, bounded retry/next-attempt and source immutability survive relaunch; expired URLs pause for authenticated renewal and landed parts remain reusable.
Wi-Fi/charging/capture-pause policy is enforced natively; logout/account switch cancels or reconciles old-owner tasks without adoption/deletion, and recovery never depends on Dart staying active.

Implement required UIDT permissions/notification/constraints and checkpoint/stop semantics; fallback WorkManager observes current OS limits, and invalid background starts require visible Resume. Native owner-bound control client calls only existing API routes for renewal/reconcile/receipts/complete.
newIssues.validation: Physical Android foreground/suspension/process restart/reboot/network-policy/URL-expiry/account-switch tests against local API+MinIO, followed by R2 qualification.

newIssues.title: Fix iOS native retry loops and background completion lifecycle
newIssues.goal: Preserve useful existing iOS transfer engineering while removing source-backed reliability risks.
newIssues.scope: Fix extraction reselection hot loops, native retry authority while Dart is suspended, BGProcessing completion timing and original-owner scheduling; converge on frozen 64 MiB/2PUT/3chunk policy.
acceptanceCriteria: Unreadable source/extraction failure does not immediately select the same part forever; native persisted retry budgets/backoff and next-attempt time govern network failures when Dart is suspended.
Background task completion reflects completed bounded work/checkpoint rather than the enqueue call; URLSession restoration and native journal recovery remain durable.
Keep file-backed background uploads, landed-part reconciliation, bounded extraction buffers and cleanup; source identity is actual byte SHA256 and provider part sizes are checked.
Enforce owner/network/charging/capture pause, expired-URL renewal and locked-device file access; force-quit cancellation/manual-reopen behavior is accurately shown and tested.
An owner-bound native control client can renew signed URLs and journal API receipts/complete while Dart is suspended, rotating secure cookies; expired auth pauses for interactive same-owner login.
newIssues.validation: Native source/extraction/network failure tests plus signed-iOS suspension/relaunch/force-quit/manual-reopen/URL-expiry/account-change and bounded-disk receipts.

newIssues.title: Qualify the mobile H.264 profile, hand detail and resource budget
newIssues.goal: Choose a measured shipping device/profile configuration without weakening required data.
newIssues.scope: Benchmark candidate hardware H.264 against retained JPEG reference on comparable repair scenes, then publish supported-device/profile matrix and numeric quality/resource release bounds.
acceptanceCriteria: Report actual total bytes/hour, RGB versus sensor contribution, actual cadence/gaps, hardware/bitstream/IDR settings, peak RAM/disk/index size, close time, battery and heat on both supported platforms.

Review decoded hands/tools/small components and real CPU landmark usefulness on motion/gloves/occlusion footage; avoid claiming matched-quality savings or anatomical/metric accuracy from file size alone.
Freeze exact shipping bitrate/profile/level/GOP/color/resource thresholds with version/digest and explicit device support/rejection behavior; no silent downgrade or unnecessary cloud GPU.
Golden/native H.264 samples pass sequential decode, IDR-safe native MP4 remux, exact mapping and Rerun0.41 paired web playback/seeking/overlay tests before the signed two-hour cloud field gate.
newIssues.validation: Attach reproducible device/build/source/model/config comparisons and reviewer decisions; unacceptable footage/profile remains unqualified and blocks pilot, rather than disabling automatic hands.

existingIssueUpdates.expectedTitle: Migrate the mobile recorder and SDK into the monorepo safely
appendAcceptanceCriteria: Import the Flutter app and required native recorder together after the recording-engineer handoff; full Python SDK is optional/reference-only. Preserve local DB/journals/signing IDs, upstream notices and import commits.

replaceTexts.old: Coordinate a source-revision handoff; import Flutter, native plugin and SDK into the agreed target paths while preserving package boundaries.
replaceTexts.new: Import Flutter and native recorder source into the root monorepo after coordinated handoff; preserve app identity, history/notices and local journals. Reuse only reviewed Python helpers/fixtures where needed; the full Stera Python SDK is not a required mobile/backend dependency.

replaceTexts.old: A clean clone contains apps/mobile, packages/stera_recorder and packages/stera-sdk without required submodules.
replaceTexts.new: A clean clone contains apps/mobile and packages/stera_recorder without required submodules; only reviewed Python helpers/fixtures are imported if reused, and full SDK source is optional/reference-only.

replaceTexts.old: Existing meaningful native/Flutter capture and SDK regression checks pass; licenses, fixtures and build instructions remain available.
replaceTexts.new: Existing meaningful native/Flutter capture checks and regression checks for any reused Python helpers pass; licenses, fixtures and build instructions remain available.

existingIssueUpdates.newTitle: Migrate the mobile app and native recorder into the monorepo safely

existingIssueUpdates.expectedTitle: Publish versioned API, task and artifact contracts
appendAcceptanceCriteria: Materialize capture-format v1 strict schemas, bridge/error contracts and cross-language generation/conformance ownership; MOB-01 owns the detailed video/sensor fixture deliverable.

existingIssueUpdates.expectedTitle: Integrate mobile login and immutable capture ownership
appendAcceptanceCriteria: Pin native google_sign_in 7.2.0; exchange ID token via pinned Better Auth REST schema, verify platform/server audiences and rotate all secure cookies. Fetch server /me role before initial enrollment; no independent custom JWT service.

Persist prior verified offline eligibility, clear it on logout, and enforce native owner-aware task pause/cancel on account change. Issued signed URLs are not revoked merely by clearing Flutter state.

existingIssueUpdates.expectedTitle: Finalize and hash closed source files before upload
appendAcceptanceCriteria: Accept native closure only after finite EOS drain, reconciled frame/sensor evidence, closed MCAP/footer and all required sidecars; failed/unresolved recording is not a complete upload source.
Hash actual immutable file bytes and seal capture profile/config/clock/calibration/count evidence; reject path+size hash, source mutation and unfinished sidecar inventories.
Final metadata excludes its own size/hash entry; compute those after atomic close and retain them in the external journal/sealed source manifest.

existingIssueUpdates.expectedTitle: Register recordings and seal the required-file inventory
appendAcceptanceCriteria: Persist capture schema/RGB profile/config digest, native close status and exact required-file/clock/calibration inventory. Reject incompatible/unclosed source declarations before job admission; worker still independently checks bytes/evidence.

existingIssueUpdates.expectedTitle: Implement the owner-bound Flutter resumable uploader
appendAcceptanceCriteria: Integrate both native adapters with shared frozen plans, transport epochs and original-owner journals; no Android unsupported guard or notification-only substitute.
64 MiB parts, two active PUTs and three temporary chunks are a measured starting policy; native recovery/backoff and API renewal work without assuming active Dart.

Preserve old local journals and frozen adaptive part plans; reconcile/retire legacy-authority MPUs and prove ownership before new API allocation. No silent 64 MiB replanning or account adoption during cutover.

existingIssueUpdates.expectedTitle: Complete collector recovery states and verified local cleanup
appendAcceptanceCriteria: Default Wi-Fi-only/charging-required, with explicit persisted collector override; pause transfers during initial-profile capture and display actual wait/error reason.

Capture setup exposes capabilities/unsupported profiles, counts/health and finalization/recovery state. Camera/background interruption stops/finalizes when safe; unfinished files remain retained and cannot masquerade as ready.

existingIssueUpdates.expectedTitle: Prove CPU hand overlays and real Rerun playback early
appendAcceptanceCriteria: Use a golden mixed-schema H.264 MCAP and paired rerun-sdk/@rerun-io/web-viewer 0.41.0 in the real Next build; record browser/codec/asset/cleanup/overlay timing evidence and regenerate new RRDs rather than assume old 0.22 compatibility.
Prove H.264 sequential decode, IDR-safe remux and explicit native-capture-to-viewer timeline mapping with real CPU hand inference; documented import support alone is not runtime qualification.

Lock a fresh compatible Python 3.12/rerun-sdk 0.41.0/MediaPipe 1.2.0/PyAV 19.0.2 worker; NumPy 2 is incompatible with historical MediaPipe0.10.21. Verify dependency resolution/imports/CPU model/video serialization in addition to browser tests; no legacy SDK monkeypatches.

existingIssueUpdates.expectedTitle: Stream MCAP and decode frames with bounded memory
appendAcceptanceCriteria: Dispatch h264_mcap_v1 versus explicit legacy jpeg_mcap_v1; decode mixed Protobuf/CDR/JSON, validate descriptor/config/clock/frame mapping and keep a persistent bounded H.264 decoder.
Decode frames once, preserve all original times, reject missing config, forbidden B frames/reordering/unknownPTS and oversized/unbounded joins; consume/hash footer/whole source before acceptance.

existingIssueUpdates.expectedTitle: Write bounded clip artifacts and a portable reader
appendAcceptanceCriteria: H.264 native-resolution MP4 clips remux original access units without reencoding; each starts at an actual IDR/config and ends within the60-second ceiling. Last clip may end at EOS. No undecodable predicted-frame starts, artificial constant FPS or silent repair/transcode.

Create separate bounded spatial H.264 VideoStream proxy RRDs with exact frame/PTS/transform mapping, allowlisted customer-safe entities and matching Rerun 0.41.0; historical JPEG uses its explicit encode path.
Rebase clipPTS=sourcePTS-firstIncludedSourcePTS while retaining sourcePTS/timebase/origin in the frame map; the viewer/overlays explicitly use that clip-relative mapping.

existingIssueUpdates.expectedTitle: Persist inline quality checks and reject corrupt candidates
appendAcceptanceCriteria: Validate actual acquired/submitted/written/dropped/unresolved and sensor counts, schema/profile/configuration, calibration/raster mapping, decoded frame identity and IDR-safe output boundaries. Unknown clock synchronization stays unknown.

existingIssueUpdates.expectedTitle: Embed the real shared Rerun viewer safely
appendAcceptanceCriteria: Replace old 0.22.1 design assumptions with matched0.41.0 SDK/viewer artifacts; self-host assets, use framework-independent start/stop adapter and qualify H.264 WebCodecs, seeking, overlays, URL reload and bounded browser memory.
Open only an explicitly authorized clip-safe RRD; direct raw-MCAP import is a compatibility fixture, never a customer data/access path.

existingIssueUpdates.expectedTitle: Qualify real R2 multipart and private viewer transfers
appendAcceptanceCriteria: Qualify physical Android and iOS multipart native recovery/policies against actual R2, including interrupted PUTs, owner switching and suspended URL renewal. MinIO/fixture success does not replace this evidence.

existingIssueUpdates.expectedTitle: Qualify a signed-device two-hour capture through cloud review
appendAcceptanceCriteria: Require signed supported Android/iOS H.264 captures under the frozen qualified profile, consecutive-session reset, independent raw sensor/calibration/drop evidence and bounded native indices/queues/EOS.

Run the full two-hour capture/upload/process/Rerun/staff-review/customer-inspection path with actual source/output hashes, frame maps, resource/cost/quality limits and documented OS background behavior. Short JPEG Pixel evidence is historical.

milestoneUpdates.M0: A clean clone builds mobile/native and Node/Python packages; versioned API plus H.264 MCAP/profile/clock schemas, generated descriptors and cross-language golden fixtures agree. Full Python SDK is optional reviewed reuse.
milestoneUpdates.M1: Signed Android/iOS Google identities, truthful hardware H.264/raw-sensor capture, bounded EOS/close/recovery and actual background multipart adapters work with owner-bound journals and sealed stable files. Unsupported profiles and failures are explicit.
milestoneUpdates.M2: Golden and native H.264 plus historical JPEG pass bounded one-pass CPU hands, IDR-safe MP4 remux, paired Rerun0.41 review assets, resource/fault tests and measured mobile codec/device qualification.
milestoneUpdates.M5: The frozen qualified device/profile passes signed physical two-hour capture/upload/cloud-process/review with complete sensor/clock/calibration/drop/hash evidence, measured limits/cost and staff/customer UAT. No design-only or historical JPEG evidence substitutes.
